profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 43 (Digital Realty missing-address campaign): confirmed this building code is a real operator assigned designation but could not locate a specific address despite multiple targeted searches, flagged for future resolution.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Digital Realty is a publicly traded data center real estate investment trust. This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row, Digital Realty Northern Virginia IAD73, could not be matched to a specific street address this session despite the building code itself being a real, operator assigned designation consistent with this operators sequential IAD numbering for its Northern Virginia campus. The operators own dedicated IAD73 page returned a 403 access denied error on a fresh fetch this session, and targeted searches across Baxtel, datacenterHawk, Inflect, and DataCenterMap did not surface a specific address for this building code, unlike the successful searches this session for IAD41, IAD42, IAD43, and IAD55. No specific address is asserted for this row.

profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Northern Virginia (Ashburn/Loudoun/Sterling/Reston/Bristow/Fairfax) data center campus, one of the largest concentrations of colocation buildings in Data Center Alley. Digital Realty publishes individual building pages with real street addresses for most named buildings in this campus (for example IAD37 at 44060 Digital Loudoun Plaza Bldg K, IAD36 at 43780 Digital Loudoun Plaza Bldg H, IAD40 at 44372 Round Table Plaza Bldg M, VA4 at 8217 Linton Hall Road in Bristow, VA3 at 1780 Business Center Drive in Reston), confirmed via digitalrealty.com and third-party colocation marketplaces (UPSTACK, datacenterHawk).
